digest:
- Walmart reported its sub-30-minute delivery volume nearly tripled in Q3 due to expanded store networks, increasing commercial auto exposure hours and requiring telematics calibration for fleet utilization rates [1].
- GEODIS launched its U.S. Final Mile Index showing delivery costs up 10.5% year over year, tightening fleet margins and increasing the value proposition of our risk-reducing telematics insurance [8].
- CXT Software and Dispatch Science combined to create a unified agentic last-mile transportation management system, serving as potential data integration partners for last-mile fleet underwriting [2].
- Delhivery returned to profitability in Q2 with a Rs 40.6 crore profit as revenue rose 20%, indicating robust delivery demand that supports fleet expansion and commercial auto policy purchases [3].
